title: Coral and the Summer Anew
author: Zephyrine Almeida
blurb: Petra Eastwick, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
